title: Handheld Portable Fan ,Speed Adjustable Turbo Mini Fans, 5000mAh Battery
body_html:

----Lasted Tubo fan protable - the handheld fan with high-speed brushless motor with 12 blades, the protable fan can reach speed up to 13,000 RPM, range delivering a strong airflow with a maximum wind speed of up to 6.8m/s.   Bringing you an incredible wind cooling experience, turbo mini fan is making your whole body feel cooler.
----Double Cooling Fan for Hot Summer- Double Chip control, the held fan doesn’t only bring strong airflows, but also using the cooling pad to rapidly cool down your skin,not cold air like an AC. 
----Long Battery Rechargeable Fan -our protable tubo fan euipped with 5200mah battery, can last for 10 hours in 1st gear fan endurance, the portable fan is designed to meet your cooling needs for the whole day.
 ----1-100 Speed Adjustable Fan - This personal fan adopts press button design, long press button to adjust the speed.   The portable fan can customize speeds from 1 to 100, meeting your various wind power needs in any scene.
 ----Portable Hand Fan For traveling - Mini Small Fan features a stylish and portable design, it is easy to carry into your bag or backpack. Ideal for hiking, walking, shopping and travel.
